adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed re-review repaired doi__10.3390_md11124761 from framework-test rework state to accepted_with_cautions. The local paper supports clavatustide A/B cytotoxicity against HCC cell lines, normal-hepatocyte comparison, and HepG2 G1 cell-cycle arrest; it does not support antimicrobial MIC claims or a direct molecular mechanism. DBAASP rows are retained with cytotoxicity scope and non-linear sequence-normalization cautions.

caution_findings.record: 16 linked DBAASP assay/experiment rows for DBAASPN_18527 and DBAASPN_18528
caution_findings.note: Primary source verifies clavatustide A/B as cyclic depsipeptide chemical structures, but local linked_sequence_records.jsonl is empty and the entity is not a simple linear AMP sequence; database rows are retained with source-supported cytotoxicity values and explicit non-normalized sequence status.

Local primary material supports HCC/L02 cytotoxicity and cell-cycle effects only. No antimicrobial MIC/MBC/hemolysis assay was found in XML, PDF, supplement, or linked database rows, so final rows must not be used as antibacterial AMP evidence.
Supplementary text lists spectral figures S1-S25 and contributes structure-support evidence, not additional activity/toxicity/mechanism tables.

Dose-response curves and cell-cycle figures were reviewed as locators. Exact plotted point values were not digitized because the source text reports IC50/max-effect-dose values and Table 2 reports phase percentages required for the gate.
